_readme: DEMO / DEV CONFIG — replace or extend before any production use. Run `wombat keygen` to generate a real keypair, then add the printed public key as a new entry in `issuers` with the roles you need. The entry below uses the fixture demo key whose private seed was intentionally discarded (R19); it can sign the piura-demo fixture bundles but NOT any new bundle.

issuers.name: wombat-fixture-demo (clave privada descartada — solo para verificar el bundle piura-demo/v0)
